name: rdp-secondary-port-win
description: (TermService cannot be stopped live on Server 2025; second listener materialises at next reboot)
script:
$Error.Clear()
if (-not $RDP_EXTRA_PORT) { $RDP_EXTRA_PORT = '3388' }
# Secondary RDP listener on a nonstandard port (W5-08).
$ts = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server'
Set-ItemProperty $ts fDenyTSConnections 0 -Force
$ws = Join-Path $ts 'WinStations'
if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $ws 'RDP-Tcp2'))) {
    $src = Get-Item (Join-Path $ws 'RDP-Tcp')
    $dst = New-Item -Path (Join-Path $ws 'RDP-Tcp2') -Force
    foreach ($n in $src.GetValueNames()) {
        $dst.SetValue($n, $src.GetValue($n), $src.GetValueKind($n))
    }
}
Set-ItemProperty (Join-Path $ws 'RDP-Tcp2') PortNumber ([int]$RDP_EXTRA_PORT) -Force
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName 'RDP-Secondary' -Direction Inbound -Action Allow -Protocol TCP -LocalPort $RDP_EXTRA_PORT -ErrorAction Ignore | Out-Null
# TermService cannot be stopped live on a DC: Restart-Service waits forever. The
# second listener materialises at the next boot from the WinStations key.
Write-Output "RDP-Tcp2 key set on port $RDP_EXTRA_PORT; RDP-Secondary rule open; listener materialises at next boot"
